import copy,json
from work import evaluate
with open('requests.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: evidence=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: report=json.load(f)
actual=[evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]
assert report==actual,(report,actual)
assert actual==[{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['S1','X1'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']},{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['D1'],'unknowns':[]}]
expected_fields={'status','value','sources','unknowns'}
assert all(set(x)==expected_fields for x in actual)
base={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}
def test(req,ev,pol,want):
    before=copy.deepcopy((req,ev,pol)); got=evaluate(req,ev,pol)
    assert got==want,(got,want); assert (req,ev,pol)==before
test({'claim':'c','conditions':{}},[],{'required_conditions':['b','a']},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','b']})
test(base,[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'supersedes':'old'}],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
test(base,[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},{'source':'bad','claim':'other','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'supersedes':['old']}],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'supported','value':1,'sources':['old'],'unknowns':[]})
test(base,[{'source':'u','claim':'c','value':8,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':False}],{'required_conditions':['a','b'],'require_verified':True},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
test(base,[{'source':'z','claim':'c','value':{'q':[1,2]},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':{'q':[1,3]},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
test(base,[{'source':'f','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['f'],'unknowns':[]})
test(base,[{'source':'n','claim':'c','value':None,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'supported','value':None,'sources':['n'],'unknowns':[]})
print(json.dumps({'report':actual,'checks':'passed'},sort_keys=True))
